payload.sessionId: uuid — the live session whose microphone recognised the element or the sound; it must be live with the microphone on (live-only-local-audio)
payload.entityId: uuid — the element recognised, of the session's campaign; exactly one of entityId and soundId (suggestion-target)
payload.soundId: uuid — the sound recognised, of the session's campaign; exactly one of entityId and soundId (suggestion-target)
payload.matchedText: text — the name or alias heard in the local transcription, never blank
